watches.name: Dusk Knight 40.5mm
watches.description: Introducing the Northern Star Watch - a blend of sophistication and luxury at an affordable price. With its sleek 40.5 mm case size, this watch offers elegance and precision for both men and women. Powered by the reliable Japanese Movement Miyota 90S5, the watch ensures accurate timekeeping. It's adorned with 19 GRA certified Moissanite stones, including 17 (.8mm) and 1 (1.5mm), making it truly unique. Built to last, the watch features high-quality stainless steel 316LSS construction. The mirror-like shine adds dimension, and the double anti-reflective sapphire crystal glass keeps the watch scratch-free and easy to read. Waterproof up to 5 atm, the watch is suitable for various activities, from outdoor adventures to poolside relaxation. Beyond its functionality, this watch represents compassion and giving. Upgrade your wristwear with the Northern Star Watch today.

watches.name: Icy Sentinel (Stainless Steel) 40.5mm
watches.description: The Sentinel is a remarkable timepiece that marries style and substance. With a slim profile of just 10.10mm and dimensions measuring 40.5mm in diameter straight edge to edge, 34 mm dial and 44mm lug to lug, it boasts a sleek design. The dial features a triple-tiered face with luminous Roman numerals set against a mother-of-pearl white background, accented by moissanite gemstones at the cardinal points. An inner ring, polished in stainless steel, complements the outer spectacle. The Ice blue sunburst dial is matched by a unique twisted crown, all encased within a distinctive hexagonal brushed and polished stainless steel case. A genuine leather-wrapped top plate crown adds a touch of luxury, while an open window screw-down caseback showcases the Premium Miyota 90S5 movement. Double AR Sapphire Crystal on both sides ensures crystal clarity. Waterproof up to 5 atm, the watch is suitable for various activities, from outdoor adventures to poolside relaxation."The Sentinel" is more than a watch; it's a statement of timeless elegance and impeccable taste, destined to be an inseparable part of your journey through time.
